help:
decs bench [<dir>...] [--view available|active|decide|all|waiting|deferred]

  decs bench          opens every folder registered with decs projects, from anywhere
  decs bench .        opens only the project the current directory is in
  decs bench ~/Code/a ~/Code/b   opens only these (--dir also works)
  decs bench --json   everything bench shows — each view's rows, every node's detail — as one JSON object, for a window that draws it
  decs bench --json --node <id>   one node's detail, archived ones included


Tabs across the top: Available N / Active N / Decide N / All / Waiting N (⇥ to switch, opens on Available).
  Available  what is moving now: running, waiting outside, startable, needing a decision, answered and awaiting an AI (tree, ancestors shown dim)
  Active     running and needing a decision (tree)
  Decide     what you must rule on, grouped by project, AI-stuck ones first
  All        every node; finished ones fold into "✓ Completed N" / "✓ Finished N", +/- expands
  Waiting    held up outside
             the last row, "Deferred N", is what you put off with d (or decs defer), + expands; the state doesn't change,
             it and its subtree are out of Available/Active/Decide. --view deferred opens Waiting with it expanded.
Old --view tree|owner|running|timeline|done still works (maps to the nearest view).
When there are external sources, a line under the tabs says whether they're clear. Left is nodes, right is the current one.
↑↓ picks a node, ←→ / +- fold/unfold, digits answer, Enter takes the default, w jumps to the next decision, g jumps by number, d defers/undefers, ? shows every key, , opens Settings.
Mouse works too: click a tab name, a node, an option, an attachment; the wheel scrolls whichever pane it's over.
Press o to view a screenshot right in the terminal (iTerm2 / kitty family; tmux swallows it,
set DECS_IMAGES=iterm with passthrough enabled).
Register folders with: decs projects add <dir> (decs init does this automatically); stored in ~/.decs/config.json.
With nothing registered, it falls back to walking up from the current directory for a decisions/ folder.

helpScreen:
Five tabs, ⇥ / ⇧⇥ to switch (digits are reserved for answering); opens on Available:
    Available  what is moving now: running, waiting outside, startable, needing a decision, answered
               and awaiting an AI; the project tree, with ancestors listed dim so you can see where
               a match hangs
    Active     what is actually happening: running and needing a decision (answered doesn't count);
               same tree, ancestors dim
    Decide     what you must rule on, grouped by project; AI-stuck ones (◆ bold) first, then early-
               answerable ones (◆ dim)
    All        every node, including finished ones: finished children fold into one row,
               "✓ Completed N"; finished top-level nodes fold into "✓ Finished N" at the end of each
               project, +/- expands/collapses
    Waiting    held up outside (a colleague, a customer, a vendor, a service coming back): who it's
               waiting on, how long; the longest wait is at the top
               the last row, "⏷ Deferred N", is what you put off with d, collapsed by default,
               + expands / - collapses (remembered)

  Defer (d)   not archiving (not done yet), the state doesn't change; it and its sub-nodes don't
              appear in Available/Active/Decide; shown dim in All; press d again in Waiting's
              "Deferred" row (or in All) to undefer

  The numbers on the tabs: how many in Available/Active/Decide/Waiting (deferred ones don't count,
  their number is on the "Deferred N" row); with external sources, a line under the tabs says
  whether they're clear.

  Status   ○ to do  ◐ running (grey = past stale_after with no movement, red = past twice that)
           ⏸ waiting outside
           ◆ needs a decision: bold yellow = AI stuck, dim yellow = can decide early
           ✓ completed  ✕ closed
           green = answered, awaiting an AI (you answered, an AI hasn't picked it up): shape
           unchanged — a decision stays ◆, a task stays ○ / ◐
  ◆ at the start of a row   something below (in the sub-nodes) needs a decision
  ▸ / ▾   a node with children, collapsed / expanded; +N is how many are hidden
  Progress  ████░░ 60% 3 minutes ago; grey = past stale_after with no update, red = past twice that

  ↑ / ↓          previous / next node
  ← / →          (tree) collapse / expand; already collapsed, ← jumps to the parent; already
                 expanded, → enters the first child; nothing left to expand, → enters the body's
                 image picker instead (same as i)
  - / +          (Available, Active, All) collapse / expand the node under the cursor, or a
                 "✓ Completed N" row; remembered, so it's the same next time you open bench
                 (stored in $DECS_HOME/bench-state.json, one per person; ← / → also remember it)
  w              jumps to the next decision an AI is stuck on (by urgency)
  g (or :)       type a number to jump (64, W305, web:305 all work), ⏎ jumps, Esc cancels; if it's
                 not in the current view, bench switches and expands it automatically
  d              defers / undefers the node under the cursor (recorded as owner); after deferring,
                 the cursor moves to the next row; the AI working on it is told "owner deferred",
                 and leaves it alone until you undefer it
  j / k          scroll the body down / up one line; Ctrl-F / ^B a screen, Ctrl-D / ^U half a
                 screen, Home / G (End) to the top / bottom
  1-9            answers by option number (asks to confirm first, you can add a note); pressing a
                 digit again on an answered node changes the answer
  ⏎              answers with this node's written default
  nodes with sub-questions   1 = all defaults; 2 = step through: ↑↓ change question, ←→ or the
                 option key to pick, n writes a change, ⏎ submit
  N              adds a reply (recorded as human · owner); it doesn't count as an answer, but the
                 node goes back to an AI
  X              closes this node (not doing it); asks why, blank = obsolete
  A              seen it, nothing to do → marks it completed and archives it; doesn't go in the
                 queue
  T / B / U      pin to top / bottom / unpin (only for nodes needing a decision)
  images in the body   each image is one row, 🖼️ name (in the body's own ![](…) position;
                 attachment images come last)
  i              enters the body's image picker: ↑/↓ picks in reading order (scrolls there
                 automatically), i again (or ⏎/Space) opens the full-size view, O opens it in the
                 system viewer, ← / Esc goes back to the list; Z (condensed) only selects among the
                 images actually shown
  in the full-size view   ←/→ previous / next image (every image on this node, says so at either
                 end); +/- zoom, arrow keys pan once zoomed in, 0 resets, O opens in the system
                 viewer, q / Esc back to the body, keeps whichever image you were on
  o / O          o views an attachment (an image opens full-size in the terminal, anything else
                 goes to the system); O always opens it in the system viewer; several attachments
                 ask for a digit first
  H              opens this node's HTML attachment in a browser
  ,              opens Settings — language, right-to-left text, mouse, …; , or Esc closes it
  Z              condense/expand the body      R re-read from disk      q quit

  Mouse: click a tab name to switch, a node on the left to select it, an option to answer, an
         attachment to open it, a 🖼️ row to view it full-size;
         the wheel/trackpad scrolls whichever pane it's over, one row at a time; the left pane
         only scrolls the list, it doesn't change the selection.
  In the body, a paragraph starting "{{user}} | …" is yours (magenta); one starting "{{agent}} | …" is an
  AI's record (blue).

  press any key to go back
